split.ranking: sha256 of seed:original_episode_id, ascending; first ceil(n*0.1) go to validation

preprocessing.image_resize: Pillow bilinear, RGB, CHW float32 / 255; stored images are not flipped
preprocessing.vocabulary: lowercase word tokens from training instructions only, PAD=0 UNK=1
preprocessing.state_normalization: per-dimension population mean/std on training frames only; std below 1e-6 becomes 1
preprocessing.action_normalization: same z-score rule; inverse normalization before controller clipping [-1,1]

synthetic_fit.criterion: final MSE below 20 percent of initial MSE; engineering control only

verification.scope: No new simulation, GPU work, formal policy training, or confirmation evaluation
